items.title: D'Andre Swift: Big numbers in Thanksgiving win
items.text:
Swift carried the ball nine times for 65 yards and a touchdown and caught seven of eight targets for 97 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Goes unclaimed on waivers
items.text:
Rodgers went unclaimed on waivers and is now a free agent, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer and Netflix reports.

items.title: Sam LaPorta: Finds end zone in Thanksgiving loss
items.text:
LaPorta caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.

items.title: Jameson Williams: Six grabs on Thanksgiving
items.text:
Williams caught six of nine targets for 68 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 12 yards on his lone carry.

items.title: Jared Goff: Tops 300 yards in Week 12 loss
items.text:
Goff completed 25 of 36 passes for 313 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 10 rushing yards on three carries.
